data.name: PO Price Compliance
data.definition: Share of POs released at the agreed framework or contract rate.
data.formula: POs at agreed rate ÷ total POs

data.name: On-Time Delivery
data.definition: Share of PO lines delivered by the acknowledged date.

data.name: Long-Lead Items on Plan
data.definition: Share of long-lead items ordered and tracked against the segment / wave schedule.
data.formula: Long-lead items on plan ÷ total long-lead items

data.name: PO Closure Rate
data.definition: Share of eligible POs closed after final match and vendor evaluation.

data.name: Change Control Compliance
data.definition: Share of PO amendments processed through Procurement Change Control.

data.name: Supplier Response Rate
data.definition: Share of invited suppliers that submit a quotation.

data.name: RFx Cycle Time
data.definition: Days from RFx issue to a signed Technical Compliance Sheet.

data.name: Technical Evaluation Turnaround
data.definition: Days from valid quotations to completed technical evaluation.

data.name: Quotation Validity Rate
data.definition: Share of received quotations that are complete and valid.

data.name: Single-Source Justification Rate
data.definition: Share of single-source awards with an approved justification.

data.name: Requisition-to-PO Cycle Time
data.definition: Working days from approved requisition to released PO, measured on every case across sourcing and purchasing.
data.source: Oracle Fusion Procurement · Fabric event log

data.name: On-Time Delivery Rate
data.definition: On-time delivery across the procurement processes, weighted by PO line volume.

data.name: PO Closure Rate
data.definition: PO closure across the procurement processes, weighted by eligible POs.

data.name: Urgent / Breakdown Purchase Ratio
data.definition: Share of POs raised as urgent or breakdown purchases.

data.name: Delegation of Authority Compliance
data.definition: Share of procurement approvals made within the Delegation of Authority.

data.name: Returned Material Percentage
data.definition: Value of material returned to suppliers as a share of received value.

data.name: Local Content Reported Coverage
data.definition: Share of POs with local content reported.
data.formula: POs with local content ÷ total POs

data.name: Requisition-to-PO Cycle Time
data.definition: Requisition-to-PO Cycle Time for Supply Chain Management, aggregated from its sub-functions.
data.formula: Volume-weighted across SCM sub-functions · Procurement Operations 100% today

data.name: On-Time Delivery Rate
data.definition: On-Time Delivery Rate for Supply Chain Management, aggregated from its sub-functions.
data.formula: Volume-weighted across SCM sub-functions · Procurement Operations 100% today

data.name: PO Closure Rate
data.definition: PO Closure Rate for Supply Chain Management, aggregated from its sub-functions.
data.formula: Volume-weighted across SCM sub-functions · Procurement Operations 100% today

data.name: Urgent / Breakdown Purchase Ratio
data.definition: Urgent / Breakdown Purchase Ratio for Supply Chain Management, aggregated from its sub-functions.
data.formula: Volume-weighted across SCM sub-functions · Procurement Operations 100% today

data.name: Delegation of Authority Compliance
data.definition: Delegation of Authority Compliance for Supply Chain Management, aggregated from its sub-functions.
data.formula: Lowest result across SCM sub-functions (compliance gate)

data.name: Returned Material Percentage
data.definition: Returned Material Percentage for Supply Chain Management, aggregated from its sub-functions.
data.formula: Volume-weighted across SCM sub-functions · Procurement Operations 100% today

data.name: Local Content Reported Coverage
data.definition: Local Content Reported Coverage for Supply Chain Management, aggregated from its sub-functions.
data.formula: Volume-weighted across SCM sub-functions · Procurement Operations 100% today

data.name: Construction Supply Efficiency Index
data.definition: Composite index of on-time delivery, returned material and urgent purchases: how efficiently supply supports construction.
data.aggregation: Composite index of contributing KPI scores

data.name: Support Service Level Index
data.definition: Composite index of requisition-to-PO cycle time and PO closure: how well the support functions serve the core construction business.
data.aggregation: Composite index of contributing KPI scores

data.name: Operating Model Agility Index
data.definition: Composite index of Delegation of Authority compliance and local content coverage: controls and a supply base that scale with growth.
data.aggregation: Composite index of contributing KPI scores

data.name: Project Management Capability Index
data.definition: Composite index of project planning, controls and delivery capability across projects. Project Management processes are not modelled yet; long-lead planning on plan is the first driver.
data.formula: Assessed and measured across PMG processes (to be modelled)

data.name: Sustainable Economic Results Index
data.definition: Enterprise outcome: the combined result of the four strategic objectives (O1–O4), each weighted equally.
data.aggregation: Composite index of contributing KPI scores
data.formula: Σ (strategic KPI score × weight) ÷ Σ weight

data.name: Supplier Acknowledgement Time
data.definition: Hours from PO release to the supplier acknowledging the delivery date.

data.name: Three-Way Match First-Pass Rate
data.definition: Share of invoices matched to PO and receipt on the first pass, without manual exception handling.

data.name: Change Request Turnaround
data.definition: Working days to process a PO change request through Procurement Change Control.

data.name: Quotation Completeness Rate
data.definition: Share of quotations received complete at first submission (all mandatory documents and the committed lead time).

data.name: Supplier Invitation Lead Time
data.definition: Working days from an approved RFx package to the invitation being issued to suppliers.
